notes.title: Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West
  • New map 'Appaloah Valley' supporting all game modes
  • Dedicated servers now support dynamic light settings, meaning that levels can be played in morning, day, evening or night time
  • Quick join is now supported by dedicated servers, meaning that all players can choose to hop into to first available game without having to browse for servers
  • Bug fix for collision issues when throwing dynamite close to objectives
  • Spawn camp issues fixed for various maps
  • Team chat colors changed for more clarity
  • Gunslinger fanning fire rate caped to prevent cheating
  • You can click on columns in server browser again

notes.title: Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West
  • New dedicated server available.
  • Steam game server will not gain ghost players any more.
  • Loading screen now presents players in server correctly.
  • Fix of broken vote-kick.
  • Added new vote: shuffle teams.
  • Added looping dedicated server messages, defined in server_config.xml
  • Idle kick does not add time when in mounted gun.
  • Crash when opening console in client hosted server fixed.
  • Fixed bug where if player were holding mounted gun at end of round, he would block gun at next round from other players.
  • Fixed bug when cancelling class selection made you unable to interact until killed.
  • Conquest scores will stop increasing immediately when match/round is over.
  • Fixed bug where each team won one round of a match, but one team had higher total score were wrongly registered as a tie.
  • Coop games can now be hosted at a dedicated server without crashing it

notes.title: Dedicated Servers now available with Patch 1.5b
notes.content:
Patch 1.5b + Dedicated server open beta notes:

• New dedicated servers support added. They contain many new features, including:

• Map-cycles can now be defined

• Games can be password protected

• Specify max ping allowed for entering a server

• Auto kick idle players added

• Friendly fire can be turned on/off

• Administrators specified with password or steam-id

• In-game console available for administrators. (kick/ban/change map cycle/list users)

• Players can be banned or kicked from server using steam-id

• Server stores log of actions happening in game, including chat messages

• New leader-boards have been added. (kill streak, most exp per match, matches won, matches lost)

• Message of the day shown when entering server

• Ping can now be seen in score-board

• Server name can now be seen in score board

• Server version can be seen in main menu

• Server browser shows some extra info on dedicated servers

• All servers are displayed in the server browser (full and empty)

• The dedicated exe runs without Lead and Gold client installed. No steam account needed to run.

• The dedicated exe runs on machines without sound card or advanced graphics card.

notes.title: Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West
  • New map: Jacob's Bridge. Set in the northern reaches of the Wild West this map features an entirely new art set and support for several game modes Greed, Conquest, Shootout and the new game mode Demolition.
  • New game mode: Demolition pits the two gangs against each other in this Powder Keg spin off. Just as in our much appreciated Powder Keg game mode, the objective is to blow stuff up. This time both gangs play simultaneously as both attackers and defenders in a frantic battle to achieve the goal of destroying the opposing gangâ€™s objectives.
  • Added Robbery to Deadwater Ranch and Prospectors Peak
  • Fixed bugs letting players reach the spawns in Fort Turnbull, Sinner's Gulch, Prospectors Peak and Deadwater Ranch
  • Added red outlines to the charge meter on the Buffalo Rifle when it is reloading.
  • Added a new options panel (F2) for the in game help menu including: Switch teams, Change Profession and Vote-kick.
  • Added option to Change Profession at any time in the game. This will kill the character currently played.
  • Added option to Vote-kick players on your own team
  • Added chat to scoreboard (also displays at the end of the round/match)
  • Added additional wanted posters for top three on Most Wanted: CHAOS.BY.DESIGN and DN*ZUGZWANGGROO|P
  • Fixed a bug with SSAO (Screen Space Ambient Occlusion)
  • Fixed a bug with ingame key mapping

notes.title: Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West
  • In team-selection screen you can now see what classes your teammates are currently playing
  • Player camera can now be switched between left and right side by pressing V
  • You can cycle between 3 different huds by pressing F2
  • Death cam is no longer inverted, it moves just like the player cam now
  • Fix for animation bug where a player could get stuck in a pose, sliding around on the ground
  • Fixes for some rare crashes
  • Players who participated in the HUD test might need to remove the LAG folder from C:\Users\Username\AppData\Local\ (this is a hidden folder) if they are experiencing problems with new key bindings resetting

notes.title: Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Lead and Gold: Gangs of the Wild West
  • Changed how some network packets are handled to decrease position lag
  • Switch team implemented. By writing /switch team or /st in chat you will be queued to switch team. When a slot is opened or a player on the opposing side also wants to switch teams the switch will be made
  • Added in game poster of competition winner Trenk
  • Fix preventing shuffling of teams when loading new map
  • Stats accumulated in Coop/Practice and private no longer count to leaderboards
